rationale: X delivers a thorough, diff-grounded review that touches both ground-truth threads (the enum suggestion in finding #5, and test-coverage concerns in finding #2 responding to the regression-test ask) and, critically, its finding #1 (default sleep level=2 permanently bricking wake_up via the new NotImplementedError guard) plus finding #2 (guard logic untested outside hardware CI) directly hit the latent gap check about the guard being too strict for existing callers/CI.
